vb_textbox.text: I went for the brown and green gnomes to start with, often got 7, 8 or 9 mushrooms. Once that started to drop down to 1, 2 or 3 I switched to the red and purple colors. I rinse and repeated this for the duration of the test. Sometimes I would pick the opposite colored gnome and it wouldn't work, in that case I would click the same colored gnome for a few goes and then switch and that seemed to bring the high numbers back. Also don't forget to press space bar when you enter the forest!
